description: This is a test suite (unit tests) for the React component 'EntityUsage'. It uses testing-library/react and vitest for testing rendering, API calls, tab switching, and graceful handling of edge cases for the 'EntityUsage' component. It mocks external dependencies and network calls to verify component behavior under different props and data scenarios.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Sets up a mock ResizeObserver for the window object if not present.

methods.name: vi.mock
methods.description: Mocks external modules and components such as networking, activity metrics, child components, and hooks for isolated testing.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines the test suite for 'EntityUsage' component.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Clears mocks and sets default resolved return values for mocked API calls before each test.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Each 'it' block defines a specific test case validating rendering, API calls, tab switching, data handling, and special edge cases for the component.
